notes.title: Development Update #03
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors, Happy New Year!
In this development update, we are going to share things that are planned and in progress for the next update, Pre Alpha 0.6.

INVENTORY SYSTEM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592067/c0699be20fd25890fe2996a45d7e96cf227b0e59.png
(The inventory preview above is NOT FINAL, and still contains placeholder assets)
Inventory system has been completely overhauled, now utilizing grid-based inventory. New inventory features has also been added (Item action options, containers, etc).

CHARACTER MODEL
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592067/e6cfa91c67ccc172c84084858fe35ef0db78d5db.png
Character model has been updated, adding more equipment items such as clothes and gears.

AI OVERHAUL
The AI system has been overhauled, bringing more realistic AI behaviour and animation.

SCAVS
AI scavenger is currently being worked on. They will roam around the map, and will shoot you if they spot you.

GRAPHICAL IMPROVEMENTS
Distance/soft shadows has been implemented. Distance objects can now cast shadows without impacting the performance too much. Shadows will now appear more realisticly with soft shadows.

A new, better, and more performant global illumination also been implemented.
All right, thats it for Development Update 3, see you guys in Pre Alpha 0.6
Thank you!

-Levi, Region Interactive

notes.title: Development Update #02
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors,
In this development update, we are going to share things that are planned for the next update, Pre Alpha 0.5.5

FIXES

-Some performance fixes
-Zombie loot bug fix.
-Melee will slow down player in a short time, instead of locking them in position.
-More small bugs will be fixed.
-When opening inventory, player will now hold the gun in low ready.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592067/c8ee5545c726d89a05d2712e5655b108d13fdecb.png

TWEAKS

-Minor lighting/fog tweaks
-Some level design changes

ADDED

-Planned to add 1440 resolution support.
-Addition of x/y invert option
-Weapon Attachment system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592067/1a2696723d117d8907669115ebe67c91ad21d280.png
-New weapon : VSS
-Replacing Ruger pistol with CZ-75 pistol
-Addition of skill system
-Addition of new zombie variants
-Some asset rework
-Some prop building model will be replaced with interiored ones.
-Planned to add grafitis on buildings to add more details

All right, thats it for Development Update 2, see you guys in Pre Alpha 0.5.5
Thank you!

-Levi, Region Interactive

notes.title: Development Update #01
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors,
In this development update, we are going to share things that are planned for the next update, Pre Alpha 0.5

FIXES

Based on recent feedbacks, players were having issues with the hunger and thirst reduction rate.
Now, hunger and thirst will decrease 3 times slower.

We planned to do an AI rework for Pre Alpha 0.5, redoing the whole AI system.

Some models like prop vehicles, and buildings have been updated and reworked.

More small bugs will be fixed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592067/daf1b3e5d76c7c0a3e6edeaf92657aa678aed50d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592067/d5f6520be60b74e7b2e8327bc16c2644a935e04d.png

TWEAKS

Daytime sun brightness has been reduced, and fog range has been increased.

ADDED

We noticed a lot of new players are having issues with equipping weapons, so we added an indicator that highlights the correct slot when dragging an item.

Planned to add 1440 resolution support.


All right, thats it for Development Update 1
Thank you

-Levi, Region Interactive
